description: Card list of coupons / deals / cashback offers. Each card shows discount + title + description + expiry + 'Copy code' button (clipboard) + 'Get deal' CTA. Coupon types: 'code' (dashed code chip), 'deal' (gray chip), 'cashback' (filled primary chip).

coupons.hint: Each: { code?, title?, description?, expiry? (pre-formatted date string), href?, type? ('code'|'deal'|'cashback'), discount? (e.g. '20% off' — shown in the chip when no code) }. 3-12 items.
